Gulbahaar Jadau Drop Earrings

MOQ: 50 pcs
Enquire on WhatsApp

Rich in detail and rooted in traditional artistry, these earrings from our Rangmanch collection are crafted using takkar/jadau stones, brought to life in a graceful layered silhouette. The design features soft pink jadau detailing, arranged in cascading segments that create fluid movement with every step. Finished with delicate pearl bunch drops, the earrings strike a beautiful balance between structure and softness. Despite their ornate appearance, they are thoughtfully balanced for comfortable wear, making them ideal for weddings, festive celebrations, and statement ethnic looks. A timeless piece that reflects heritage craftsmanship while feeling elegant and wearable.
